name: SDN Data Retrieval Flow
description: HTTP data-retrieval flow (loop C.3c): a $HTQ HttpRequest enters on the http-request trigger, foundation/http-route emits the routing-decision JSON, foundation/decision-gate dispatches it to data-source/retrieval omm_bulk or data_query as an SDS $CAQ request (or straight to http-respond for 404s), the retrieval stream joins the decision in the gate's format branch (flatbuffer: verbatim to the response body; json: through foundation/omm-json encode) together with a deterministic FNV-1a etag, and foundation/http-respond assembles the final $HTR envelope (200/304/404) delivered to the host-model egress sink. All inter-node frames stay inside the linked-direct artifact's linear memory; engineLinkage: flatsql (loop C.7) — the retrieval node submits queries DIRECTLY to the live store engine via wasm imports (modules flatsql/flatsql_link); no storage.flatsql_* hostcalls exist on this path. Flatbuffer-branch bodies stay in engine memory as SDNE body-ref tokens; the json branch copies bytes engine->flow in-wasm.

externalInterfaces.description: Host FlatSQL engine-native retrieval ops (storage.flatsql_epoch_stream, storage.flatsql_query_stream, storage.flatsql_cache_key).

acceptedTypeSets.description: Canonical WASM-served HTTP request envelope ($HTQ, module-sdk schemas/HttpRequestAbi.fbs): METHOD, PATH (no query string), QUERY (raw, URL-encoded), HEADERS (sorted, lower-cased names), BODY, REMOTE.

inputPorts.description: One HTTP request envelope as delivered verbatim by the host pipe.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Canonical WASM-served HTTP response envelope ($HTR, module-sdk schemas/HttpResponseAbi.fbs): STATUS, HEADERS (sorted, lower-cased names), BODY. The host streams it back verbatim.

outputPorts.description: Exactly one HTTP response envelope per invoke.
